saw_lines: Indoor grow light buyers compare light spectrum, shelf size and plant type before they trust any one brand.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if the light fits their plants.
Your site shows 80,000+ customers worldwide and 3688 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Put 3688 reviews on the creative and open ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 80,000+ customers worldwide and 3688 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. A cold buyer has no proof to act on. Put 3688 reviews on the creative and open ads with a customer quote.
Your site lists prices from $14.99 to $749.00, yet 0 of 30 ads show any price. Cost left unclear makes buyers leave before they compare. Open ads with the Sun Bulb price against the cost of a lamp.

Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads say how it arrives. Plant buyers fear breakage, so silence sends them elsewhere. Show the box arriving in a video ad, and state the delivery answer in the first line.

Your site promotes free shipping on Australian orders over $140, yet 0 of 24 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to order today. Lead new buyer ads with free shipping over $140 in the first line.

ads_1: Review-led grow light creative with free shipping over $140 up front
